source_text: Omnis Israel et seniores et scribae et iudices stant hinc atque illinc arcae — dimidii contra Garizim ad benedicendum, dimidii contra Hebal ad maledicendum. Proselytus et indigena. Audienda lex tota.
pass_a_gloss: All Israel and elders and scribes and judges stand here and there of-ark — half opposite Gerizim unto blessing, half opposite Ebal unto cursing. Sojourner and native. To-be-heard law whole.
pass_b_english: [[All Israel, elders, scribes, and judges stand on both sides of the ark — half toward Gerizim for blessing, half toward Ebal for curse >> Bible:Joshua 8:33]]. Sojourner and native alike. The whole law must be heard.
